module_summary: Sequential 16x16 shift-and-add multiplier: a 3-state FSM loads operands, then for 16 cycles adds the left-shifting multiplicand into an accumulator when the right-shifting multiplier LSB is set, pulsing done at the end.

anchors.name: n2_c45
anchors.why: Idle/compute/done controller loading operands, iterating, and issuing done pulse.

anchors.name: n12_df7
anchors.why: Product accumulator updated each iteration; drives the product output.

anchors.name: n13_e74
anchors.why: Start request; in idle loads operands and begins multiplication.

anchors.name: n1_113
anchors.why: Multiplicand operand loaded into the shifting multiplicand register.

anchors.name: n11_144
anchors.why: Multiplier operand loaded into the right-shifting multiplier register.

anchors.name: n7_410
anchors.why: One-cycle done pulse signalling the product is valid.

anchors.name: n18_6d8
anchors.why: Multiplicand register shifted left each iteration, added into accumulator.

anchors.name: n17_c33
anchors.why: Multiplier register shifted right; LSB selects add or hold.

anchors.name: n15_ff5
anchors.why: Iteration counter; reaching 16 ends compute state.

anchors.name: n8_478
anchors.why: Conditional partial sum: accumulator plus multiplicand when multiplier LSB set.

anchors.name: n14_dfc
anchors.why: Terminal-count flag moving FSM from compute to done.

anchors.name: n0_756
anchors.why: Busy level while FSM is in compute state.

groups.name: mult_controller
groups.description: FSM with busy and done decode.

groups.name: shift_add_datapath
groups.description: Shifting operand registers, conditional adder and accumulator.
